title: Choose the visual world for Qendra KAZUS
question: Palette is pinned by your brief (white + sky blue). The roll assigned the Exhibition Catalogue. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Exhibition Catalogue
options.lineage: printed photo-album catalogues and gallery wall labels (like the Pustec album by Roland Beqiraj)
options.thesis: The organisation's own photographs hang like an exhibition, each with a numbered museum-style label.
materials: photo plates with sky-blue wall labels
options.viewport: A big uncropped photo plate with a numbered label and the mission set as a catalogue introduction; a thin index of plates runs along the edge.
options.risk: Can feel quiet or editorial if photos are weak; relies on the real photography.

raised.raise: Colour stays confined to hairline edges and labels while text fields stay achromatic, so the sky blue reads as light, not decoration.

options.label: The Devoll Survey Map
options.lineage: river survey sheets and topographic contour maps of the Devoll and Korce plain
options.thesis: The site is a map sheet: projects are stations along a river line, posts are field notes pinned to it.
options.viewport: A white sheet with a sky-blue river line running down the page, the mission as the sheet title, and stations for the five projects.
options.risk: Strongest story (Devoll petition, EcoAction) but the map motif can overpower the culture and Pustec work.

options.label: The Community Noticeboard
options.lineage: town-hall corkboards with pinned notices and tear-off tabs
options.thesis: News and calls are paper notices on a shared board; the Notifications tab is literally the board.
options.viewport: Notices of varied sizes pinned to a white board with a hero photo notice and a deadline tab.
options.risk: Can drift into scrapbook cliche and clutter the clean look you asked for.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.lineage: cloud-white ground with a hairline spectral fringe
options.thesis: Quiet white pages with a narrow band of colour on the edges only.
options.case: Matches the white and sky-blue brief and calm tone, but says little about advocacy; loses on clarity.

options.label: Greiman Hybrid Collage
options.case: Magenta and bitmap noise contradict the clean sky-blue brief and hurt readability for funders.
options.kept: Layers that rise to the front when touched; used for the photo gallery lightbox.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean NGO site: hero, three pillars, news cards, footer, executed carefully.
canonCard.viewport: Hero photo with mission headline and a button, cards below.
